agent_activity_summary: 1.  The agent initiated the test by navigating to the "meeting-test-project" page.
2.  The agent located and clicked the "Boards" link in the side navigation menu to access the boards list page.
3.  The agent proceeded to delete all available boards one by one. For each board ('sample1', 'sample2', and 'sample3'), the agent clicked its corresponding delete icon.
4.  After each deletion action, the agent navigated back to the main Boards page to refresh the view and target the next board in the list.
5.  Following the deletion of the final board, the agent confirmed that the page displayed no boards, successfully fulfilling the scenario's objective.
